contexts.text: The name of the one was Eliezer () = the cupidity of the good of truth of those who are within the Church... This is evident from the words uttered by Moses concerning this son at the time of his birth: Because the God of my father was for my help, and He hath delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh; and also from the fact, that the quality of the good of truth which is signified by the name of the elder son, or Gershom, is that of those who are outside the Church.
